support.answer.payment: WeChat Pay and Alipay work at most sights, restaurants and stalls. A few car parks and remote stalls take cash only, so carry a little.
support.answer.internet: Mobile data can slow down at crowded sights. Open your plan before you set off: what is saved on this phone still works offline.
support.answer.tickets: Museums and major sights usually need a timed, real-name reservation on their official account or mini program, and your ID card at the gate. Book a few days ahead for holidays.
support.answer.safety: In an emergency call 110 for police or 120 for an ambulance. Carry your ID card and keep valuables with you.

share.caption.default: 72 hours, two cities: noodles at noon, a night ferry, and a friend who knew every alley. Made with Along.
assistant.local.howto: There are four tabs. Trip turns your arrival time and city into a three to seven day plan, with lunch, dinner and where to sleep for each day. Friends finds a local volunteer or licensed guide. Stories shows travellers’ notes. You holds settings, saved places, orders and Food and stays, where you set what you avoid and show the staff a card. The round button in the middle takes photos and makes 3D keepsakes.
travel.tips.checkin: Bring your ID card: the front desk checks and registers it at check-in. Before booking a guesthouse, ask whether it can register your stay and whether it has a front desk.
